categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two mature business systems: automotive aftermarket modification and OEM front-end assembly. The aftermarket segment provides personalized exterior parts, intelligent add-ons, and functional modification products for domestic and international markets. The OEM front-end assembly segment supplies personalized exterior structural parts and intelligent cockpit control systems to vehicle manufacturers, focusing on SUV, off-road, MPV, and pickup models.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced industrial design, R&D, and manufacturing technologies including flexible manufacturing systems, integrated product development (IPD), and in-house testing centers with CNAS accreditation. It focuses on mechanical, mechatronic, and electronic control system integration, with significant patent holdings domestically and internationally. The production model combines make-to-order and safety stock strategies, supported by IT systems for rapid response and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include automotive OEMs (notably leading domestic brands like Great Wall, Chery, GAC, BYD), automotive 4S dealerships, distributors, and end consumers in the aftermarket. The company serves diverse vehicle types including SUVs, off-road vehicles, MPVs, pickups, and passenger cars, catering to both traditional and new energy vehicle brands. Major markets are domestic China and overseas regions such as North America, Oceania, Europe, and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing bases in Foshan and other domestic locations. It has a significant international presence with subsidiaries and sales in North America, Singapore, Hong Kong, and other global markets. Overseas sales account for approximately 40% of revenue, with a focus on the U.S. aftermarket and emerging international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates both upstream and midstream in the automotive supply chain. It is an Original Equipment Supplier (OES) providing front-end assembly parts to OEMs and an Original Design Manufacturer (ODM) and Original Brand Manufacturer (OBM) in the aftermarket segment, supplying personalized and intelligent automotive accessories. It controls design, development, production, and sales, positioning itself as an integrated supplier bridging OEMs and end consumers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on expanding global OEM and automotive modification businesses, emphasizing core customers, models, regions, and strategic new product categories. R&D priorities include intelligent electric off-road modification products, integrated multifunctional exterior parts, and smart cockpit control systems. The company invests in patent development, flexible manufacturing, and digital customer service enhancements, aiming to lead in product innovation and official custom modification collaborations with OEMs.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct product sales of automotive parts and systems to OEMs, 4S dealerships, distributors, and end consumers. The company employs ODM, OBM, and OES sales models, with domestic sales involving direct sales, consignment, and dealer buyout arrangements. Overseas sales are predominantly direct ODM sales. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a strong position in the domestic automotive aftermarket and OEM supply sectors, with recognized brands such as Steelcraft and WINBO. It competes with other automotive parts manufacturers and aftermarket suppliers, leveraging its integrated design-to-manufacturing capabilities and strategic partnerships with leading domestic OEMs. Its international presence and patent portfolio provide competitive advantages in global markets, especially in off-road and SUV segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 2.19 billion, a 7.1% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 150 million, up 6.92%. Domestic revenue grew by 13.34%, while overseas revenue slightly declined by 1.2%. The company maintains steady growth in both automotive aftermarket and OEM front-end assembly businesses, supported by increased sales volumes and product diversification.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes integrated one-stop automotive customization and intelligent product solutions, combining high-quality design, innovation, and flexible manufacturing to meet diverse customer needs. Its products offer enhanced vehicle protection, functionality, and aesthetic appeal, particularly for off-road and SUV models. The company’s strong patent portfolio, global R&D collaboration, and official OEM custom modification capabilities differentiate it as a leading supplier bridging OEMs and aftermarket consumers.
